An authority on the flora of the Mediterranean and chief editor of the Flora of Turkey and the Aegean Islands , Peter Davis was a renowned taxonomist based at the University of Edinburgh.

Davis remained based in Edinburgh for the rest of his career, where he was appointed Lecturer in 1950 and Professor of Taxonomic Botany in 1979. From 1959 onwards his main preoccupation was the Flora of Turkey and the East Aegean Islands , published between 1965 and 1988. This entailed much fieldwork in Turkey, where he mounted eleven expeditions between 1938 and 1966.
